descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀 First who? 
A passionate tech enthusiast eager to solve complex problems and drive digital transformation
A collaborative team player who fosters a culture of sharing, learning, and continuous improvement
Curious, adaptable, and willing to dive into new tools, frameworks, and methodologies
A confident French speaker eager to work seamlessly in a multilingual, international environment!
 Based in Romania, ready to join our vibrant hybrid setup (requiring 2-3 days per week in our Bucharest office).
 🚀 Then what? 
 IT Consultant / Tech Professional (Software Engineering, DevOps, IT Infra, QA, or Data) with the following tasks:
Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable IT solutions tailored to your domain of expertise.
Collaborate closely with product owners, stakeholders, and cross-functional Agile teams to deliver high-quality products.
Participate actively in the entire project lifecycle, from requirement analysis and architecture to deployment and monitoring.
Champion quality by ensuring code, infrastructure, data pipelines, or testing standards meet top industry benchmarks.
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize system performance.
Share your expertise, participate in code/peer reviews, and contribute to the team's technical vision.
 Required technical skills: 
 Min. 3+ years of experience in at least one of the following core IT domains:
 Software Development: Backend (Java Spring Boot) or Frontend (Angular, React).
 DevOps & IT Infra: CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), system administration (Linux/Windows), or Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
 QA (Automation or Manual): Testing methodologies, test plan creation, or automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Cucumber, etc.).
 Data Engineering: Building data pipelines, ETL processes, SQL/NoSQL databases, and working with modern data stacks.
Practical experience working in Agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) and utilizing tools like JIRA.
Familiarity with or hands-on experience in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
 Fluent in French and English (spoken and written) to effectively collaborate with our international teams and francophone clients.
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
